import subprocess, sys
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "cli.py"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
out = (r.stdout + r.stderr).strip()
assert r.returncode != 0, "no-arg run should still fail"
assert out and out != "error" and len(out) >= 8, repr(out)
print("ok")
